title: Installer enables auto-update and the daemon without extra flags
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. install.sh should install the release-sync timer and start the daemon by default (opt-out flag), so '--install-timer' disappears from the README. The check script runs install.sh against a fake HOME and asserts the units exist.
